title: Scaffale: local indexing, OCR and semantic search of a personal research archive with a local language model
description:
Indicizzazione, OCR e ricerca semantica di un archivio di ricerca personale, tutto in locale, con un modello linguistico installato sul computer

Scaffale takes a disordered research folder (PDFs, Word files, notes, spreadsheets, old databases, scans, folders of photographed pages) and turns it into a searchable archive with exact, thesaurus-based and semantic search, a link to the right page of every passage, questions to the documents answered with numbered sources, groups, themes and summaries, OCR in nine languages and Markdown transcriptions in which numbers and dates are read twice and doubtful lines are flagged. Everything runs on the local computer: the language models (bge-m3, qwen3:8b, glm-ocr) are installed locally through Ollama and no document is uploaded. Written for historical research.

Designed and developed by Massimo Sbarbaro in 2026. User interface and guides in Italian; installers for Windows and Linux.
notes: Program and guides in Italian. Developed in 2026.
